# Tuya TV Viewer v0.11.0 beta 2: Flutter

Flutter beta for Android TV and Fire TV with Tuya login, a 2×2 live grid, and full-screen selection. Supports email or phone number and password; Android 7+ and ARMv7/ARM64. Live playback was experimental: the independent protocol was alpha, MJPEG was the implemented video path, and H.264 had not been verified. A debug signing key was used; switching from an APK with a different signature may require uninstalling the earlier build.
